remarks: Beautifully updated 4 bedroom, 3.5 bath colonial on a cul-de-sac! - Stunning kitchen with newer cabinets, granite counters, and stainless steel appliances! - Light and bright family room with vaulted ceilings and skylights opens up to large back patio! - First floor bedroom with en-suite bath - Master bedroom suite on 2nd floor has been totally updated and features an en-suite bath with double sink, stunning shower with custom marble tile work, built-in niches, hand-held shower sprayer, rain shower head, and glass-door - Back patio and yard is encompassed by Green Giant arborvitaes, offering lots of privacy! - Newly paved driveway! - Brand new flooring throughout 1st floor! - Fresh paint! - Great storage space in attic + shed - Walk to multiple restaurants in Broad River and easy access to SoNo, Merritt Parkway, I-95, and more - Landlord to consider pets on a case by case basis with $100 / month pet fee
